newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill positive on Cisco.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill positive on Cisco.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said analyst Joe Bellace made positive comments on Cisco Systems Inc.
-- Raised fiscal 1997 estimate to $2.07 a share from $2.04, maintained fiscal 1998 at range of $2.65-$2.75.
-- The analyst expects Cisco to report fiscal third quarter earnings per share of $0.53-0.54, versus Wall Street consensus of $0.52, Merrill said.
-- Sees third quarter revenue at $1.70 billion, a seven percent rise over the second quarter, Merrill said.
-- Sees key driver of revenue growth to be double digit revenue growth in the U.S. Sees outlook for revenue from new products "quite favorable."
-- Cisco is expected to report third quarter results on Tuesday.
-- Cisco's shares were up three to 56-3/8 in early trading.
